name: optimize_sql_or_to_union
description: Rewrites an index-defeating OR across columns as a UNION of index scans
prompts: query.sql finds all messages sent OR received by an address. Both sender and recipient are individually indexed, but the OR across two different columns makes SQLite scan the whole table. Rewrite query.sql as a UNION of two single-column lookups (one on sender, one on recipient) so each side uses its index; keep the exact output contract - columns id, sender, recipient, subject, ordered by id, no duplicate rows (self-messages where sender = recipient must appear once, which UNION's dedup handles).

setup_files.query.sql:
-- Find messages involving a user (as sender or recipient).
-- Slow: OR across two different indexed columns defeats both indexes,
-- forcing a full scan.
SELECT id, sender, recipient, subject
FROM messages
WHERE sender = 'target@x.io' OR recipient = 'target@x.io'
ORDER BY id;

test_setup_files.test_query.py:
import sqlite3, time

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sender TEXT, recipient TEXT, subject TEXT)')
rows = []
for i in range(300_000):
    rows.append((i, f'user{i % 5000}@x.io', f'user{(i * 7) % 5000}@x.io', f's{i}'))
# a handful involving the target, scattered
rows[1000] = (1000, 'target@x.io', 'user1@x.io', 'sent-1')
rows[200000] = (200000, 'user2@x.io', 'target@x.io', 'recv-1')
rows[250000] = (250000, 'target@x.io', 'target@x.io', 'self-note')
conn.executemany('INSERT INTO messages VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', rows)
conn.execute('CREATE INDEX idx_sender ON messages(sender)')
conn.execute('CREATE INDEX idx_recipient ON messages(recipient)')
conn.commit()

sql = open('query.sql').read()

got = [tuple(r) for r in conn.execute(sql).fetchall()]
assert got == [
    (1000, 'target@x.io', 'user1@x.io', 'sent-1'),
    (200000, 'user2@x.io', 'target@x.io', 'recv-1'),
    (250000, 'target@x.io', 'target@x.io', 'self-note'),
], f'result set wrong (self-message must appear once): {got}'

# both branches must be index searches, not table scans
plan = ' '.join(str(r) for r in conn.execute('EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN ' + sql).fetchall())
assert 'SCAN messages' not in plan or 'USING INDEX' in plan.replace('SCAN messages', '', 1), \
    f'query plan still scans the table: {plan}'
assert plan.count('SEARCH') >= 2, f'expected two index searches, plan: {plan}'

REPS = 300
t0 = time.monotonic()
for _ in range(REPS):
    conn.execute(sql).fetchall()
elapsed = time.monotonic() - t0
# full scans: ~0.03s x 300 = ~10s. Indexed: well under 1s.
assert elapsed < 3.0, f'{REPS} lookups took {elapsed:.2f}s - still scanning'
print(f'PASS ({elapsed:.2f}s for {REPS} lookups)')

reference_solution.query.sql:
SELECT id, sender, recipient, subject
FROM messages
WHERE sender = 'target@x.io'
UNION
SELECT id, sender, recipient, subject
FROM messages
WHERE recipient = 'target@x.io'
ORDER BY id;

files.query.sql:
SELECT id, sender, recipient, subject
FROM messages
WHERE sender = 'target@x.io'
UNION ALL
SELECT id, sender, recipient, subject
FROM messages
WHERE recipient = 'target@x.io'
ORDER BY id;
